issue.title: Saved Markdown for every research reference (birth pointer fix and two-week backfill)
issue.description: Every research report the SASE research-highlights file hook turns into a reference carries its saved Markdown, so the Bob Refs Copy card offers C (code block), L (link), and M (Markdown). That holds for every new report on athena and apollo, and for every hook-matched report from the last two weeks.

payload.entry: LAND AUDIT / FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE before remaining-work tale: reviewed approved plan, every note on d2.1/.2/.3, commits 3a13ec6f/d38bef59, prior pointer safeguards 017b6927, candidate verification 69b7d962, and current source/tests. Fetched origin/master=d38bef59; only non-epic commit since first epic commit is 79b2859d CI tooling, no feature integration required. Verified chezmoi 62806ca3 and live hook command=bob_research_capture, sidecars=[research], timeout=300.0 on both hosts. Existing attach CLI suite: 19 passed with render tools. epic-symbols empty; no symvision recipe. All 19 newly repaired pointers are present. d2.3 #2: supplementary overlap evidence recorded on existing bob-cli-co and its active batch-17 owner, no duplicate task; old-set membership not proved, so co remains open. d2.3 #3: retained as required d2 backfill/adoption acceptance work, not deferred into a new task. The 55/72 skip rate breached the approved 10% stop-before-write gate; doctor still has the machine_load orphan. Fresh scratch rendering of its three text blocks reproduces 2/3: pdftotext loses one U+27F3 glyph, causing exact-line match_lines to discard the whole line. Additional epic integration defect: adoption title failure followed by an explicit same-byte candidate rewrites code.json from markdown/anchor to attached/text_match; preserve the better catalog across all fallback paths. New JSON integration defect: write-mode stdout starts with committed <sha>, not pure JSON; routed to causal active batch-17 epic, with d2 tale owning the shared fix. No new tasks created after sase_new_task duplicate and active-epic sweep. cy already closed with its named orphan repaired; no reopening needed. Durable detailed evidence and repro: file:explicit:c61a26370b705cae1446a6ed. Epic remains open until the bounded repair, backfill gate, and doctor acceptance pass. No parent_bead.

Acceptance blocker (2026-10-27): exact-source dry-run of all 55 pointerless candidates verified 17 and skipped 38. Against the approved original denominator 72, 38/72 = 52.78%, above the unchanged 10% stop gate; no live attach writes were made. The machine_load_accounting_transparency orphan store exactly matches its hook-time source SHA-256, but orphan adoption and explicit exact-source verification both fail at 2/3 blocks, so its source_markdown pointer remains absent. The exact-source inventory, full dry-run verdicts, representative comparisons, host smokes, and checks are attached as file:explicit:189960637c2c461f1b41e91b, file:explicit:65cf00f6aef47b5c575e10e2, and file:explicit:0b7f8779ba750441f4469595.
